scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter lhc run build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter lhc run build && pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.test:all: pnpm --filter lhc run build && pnpm -r --if-present test:all
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.verify:all: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:all
